about.p1: Safeen Trucks is a marketplace for heavy trucks and truck parts in the Kurdistan Region and Iraq. Buyers search, compare and contact sellers directly. Sellers reach the whole country from one listing.
about.p2: We keep the platform simple on purpose: clear listings, real photos, honest prices, and a direct line to the seller by WhatsApp or phone.
about.p3: Every listing is reviewed before it goes live, and dealers can apply for verification so buyers know who they are dealing with.

help.sellBody: Create an account, tap Sell, choose truck or part, add photos and details, then publish. Our team reviews new listings, usually within a day.
help.buyBody: Search or filter, open a listing, and contact the seller on WhatsApp or by phone. Safeen Trucks does not handle payments — you agree the price and the handover directly with the seller.
help.safetyBody: Inspect the truck before paying. Never send a deposit to someone you have not met. Report any listing that looks fake or misleading.

contact.p1: Questions, problems with a listing, or dealer enquiries — get in touch and we will reply as soon as we can.
contact.hours: We answer during business hours, Saturday to Thursday.

privacy.p1: We collect only what the marketplace needs: your account details, the listings you publish, and the contact number buyers use to reach you.
privacy.p2: Your phone and WhatsApp numbers appear on listings you publish, because that is how buyers contact you. Your email address is never shown publicly.
privacy.p3: We record anonymous usage signals such as listing views and how often the WhatsApp and Call buttons are pressed, so sellers can see how their listings perform.
privacy.p4: We do not sell your personal data. You can ask us to delete your account and listings at any time.

terms.p1: By using Safeen Trucks you agree to publish accurate information about what you are selling, including condition, mileage and price.
terms.p2: Safeen Trucks is a listing platform. We are not a party to any sale, we do not hold funds, and we do not guarantee the condition of any truck or part.
terms.p3: We may pause, reject or remove listings that are misleading, duplicated, illegal, or reported by other users, and we may suspend accounts that break these rules.
terms.p4: Verification badges reflect checks we carried out at a point in time. They are not a guarantee of any transaction.
